_comment: STARTING routing map for an application repo. check-change-routing.mjs fires a rule when the change's added/changed files match its 'when' globs, then requires each 'requires' artifact to be part of the SAME change (or a valid waiver). It checks PRESENCE and ROUTING only; 'ownerGate' names the gate that checks the artifact's CORRECTNESS, which you wire separately. Tune every glob to your stack and delete what does not apply. '**' spans directories; '*' and '?' do not cross '/'. A rule keyed on 'added' needs --added-list passed (CI computes it from git diff --diff-filter=A).

rules.description: A database schema change is a decision and a deployment risk. Record the why (ADR) and prove the migration is safe (migration-safety).

requires.hint: the migration file carrying expand-and-contract, concurrent indexes, and a safe NOT NULL path

rules.description: A change to authentication, sessions, or access control must ship a @security scenario that tests the control (owasp-secure-coding-bdd).

requires.hint: add a @security Given/When/Then that exercises the auth control

rules.description: A user-facing UI change must carry an accessibility verdict (universal-accessibility-wcag).

requires.hint: attach the axe run output or the manual checklist verdict for the changed surface

rules.description: Production source should not change without a test moving with it (comprehensive-test-strategy).

requires.hint: add or update the test that covers the changed behavior

waivers.reason: EXAMPLE ONLY: a pure rename with no behavior change; delete this entry. A real waiver names a real reason, an approver, and an expiry so it cannot linger.
